title: The Best Prime Day Soundbars Deals to Instantly Upgrade Your Audio
author: John Brandon
text: Get the best Prime Day deals on editor-approved gear, straight to your inbox.By signing up, you agree to our user agreement (including class action waiver and arbitration provisions), and acknowledge our privacy policy.All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.Amazon Prime Day is here, and I found the best Prime Day soundbar deals to upgrade your TV audio. Some are close to 40 percent off, but you'll need an Amazon Prime membership to access many of the best deals.I've covered all sorts of AV and TV gear for WIRED, including guides to the best soundbars, best art TVs, best RGB TVs, and the best home theater projectors. A soundbar remains one of the best ways to instantly improve your home entertainment setup. The right audio setup transforms movies—bullets in Top Gun: Maverick ricochet around the room, planes swoop down from the ceiling, and explosions shake couch cushions.If you're still using your TV speakers, I implore you to grab on of these soundbars on sale. And be sure to check out our other sale coverage of the Absolute Best Prime Day Deals, the Best Prime Day Tech Deals, the Best Prime Day Headphone Deals, and more.WIRED Featured DealsThe best soundbar deal: Sonos Beam Gen 2 for $359 ($140 off)The best budget soundbar deal: Sony S100F 2.0 Channel Soundbar for $98 ($62 off)The best soundbar system deal: TCL S65K S Series 5.1 for $230 ($170 off)The best all-in-one soundbar deal: Sonos Arc Ultra for $900 ($200 off)Best Prime Day Soundbar DealsPhotograph: Simon HillCourtesy of SonosSonosBeam (Gen 2)$499 $359 (28% off) Amazon$499 $369 (26% off) Sonos$499 $369 (26% off) Best BuySonos recently launched the Sonos Beam Ultra, so it's no surprise that this older model is on sale right now. It's a highly capable, compact soundbar with ample connectivity—you can plug it into your TV, but it can also connect to Wi-Fi, pair with other Sonos speakers, and stream using Apple AirPlay 2. Plus it supports Bluetooth connectivity for listening to music off a mobile device.
